_about: FCI country (or Wikidata P495 value) -> place on the map: kind, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, Wikidata item whose P625 gives the point and P30 the continent. Drafted with Claude Code on 2026-11-04; reviewed=false until Paul checks it. Extended to the full Parker breed set on 2026-11-09: new places are drafts (reviewed=false).

entries.label: Japan
entries.basis: FCI country name; Wikidata item found by label, P625 gives the point.

entries.label: China
entries.basis: FCI country name; Wikidata item found by label, P625 gives the point.
doubts: Wikidata P495 of the Pug points to a "China" item without ISO code (historical China), not to Q148.

entries.label: Tibet (China)
entries.basis: FCI writes "Tibet (China)": ISO code of China (CN), point from Q17269 Tibet Autonomous Region (P625).
doubts: Country CN but point in Tibet: the label keeps the FCI wording. Tibet as a region (no ISO) would be the alternative.

entries.label: Belgium and France
entries.basis: Draft (Claude Code, 2026-11-09). The FCI names two countries: kept as a two-country region with no ISO code. Wikidata Q2052849 (Belgium–France border) has two P625 points, so the point is the P625 of Q31 Belgium, the first country the FCI names.
doubts: Two countries for one breed (Bichon Frise, Bouvier des Flandres, Papillon), drawn at the Belgium point: alternatives are one star per country, or a point on the border.

entries.label: Central Africa
entries.basis: Draft (Claude Code, 2026-11-09). FCI region kept as a region (Paul, 2026-11-04 rule for Middle East); P625 of Q27433 Central Africa gives the point.

entries.label: Central Mediterranean
entries.basis: Draft (Claude Code, 2026-11-09). FCI region kept as a region; Wikidata has no item for the central part, so the point is the P625 of Q72499 Mediterranean Basin.
doubts: The Mediterranean Basin point may sit far from the central Mediterranean (Malta, Sicily) the FCI means.

entries.label: Northern Russia and Siberia
entries.basis: Draft (Claude Code, 2026-11-09). FCI region kept as a region; point from Q5428 Siberia (P625).
doubts: The FCI wording names two areas; only Siberia gives the point.
